problem: chain-evaluator.sh injects advisory followup_messages but leaves state management to the builder. When phase=building, builder must manually: (1) set phase to evaluating, (2) create evaluator-active flag, (3) launch /evaluator. Missing step 1 or 2 silently breaks the trust boundary. ACAM gap: Intermediate has advisory routing; Advanced requires automated state transitions.
proposed_solution: chain-evaluator.sh auto-advances state when phase=building: (1) writes phase=evaluating to contract.json in-place, (2) creates .evaluator-active flag, (3) returns imperative followup_message with exact /evaluator invocation syntax. For phase=evaluating+unverified, returns a static EVAL FAIL message with max-2-retry reminder. Honest scope: final /evaluator invocation remains manual (Cursor hook API limitation).
acceptance_criteria: AC1: When phase=building, chain-evaluator.sh writes phase=evaluating to contract.json in-place, creates .cursor/hooks/.evaluator-active, and returns stdout JSON with followup_message containing both 'Launch /evaluator now' and 'Phase auto-advanced to evaluating'

AC2: When phase=building transition fires, chain-evaluator.sh appends a breadcrumb to .harness/breadcrumbs.jsonl: {role:system, type:dispatch, feat:<contract task_id or empty>, msg:'chain-evaluator: auto-advanced to evaluating, evaluator-active flag set', result:pass}
AC3: When phase=evaluating and verified=false, followup_message contains 'EVAL FAIL — fix and retry' and static max-retry reminder (e.g. 'max 2 retests per harness rule'); no breadcrumb scan required
AC4: When phase=negotiating or negotiated, followup_message updated to imperative: 'Contract negotiation complete. Set phase to building in .harness/contract.json and start implementation now.'

AC5: When contract.json cannot be patched (write error) or .cursor/hooks/ directory cannot be created, chain-evaluator.sh logs the error and returns followup_message: 'MANUAL: set phase=evaluating in contract.json, touch .cursor/hooks/.evaluator-active, then launch /evaluator'

AC7: pytest unit tests in a temp chdir fixture: (a) phase=building → exit 0, contract.json phase=evaluating, .evaluator-active created, breadcrumb appended, stdout JSON contains 'Launch /evaluator now' and 'Phase auto-advanced to evaluating'; (b) phase=building with contract.json read-only → exit 0, stdout contains MANUAL fallback message; (c) phase=evaluating unverified → exit 0, stdout contains 'EVAL FAIL' and static max-retry reminder; (d) phase=evaluating verified → exit 0, stdout is '{}'
edge_cases: EC1: contract.json has no task_id field — breadcrumb feat is empty string, not crash
EC2: .cursor/hooks/ directory does not exist — attempt mkdir; on failure use AC5 MANUAL fallback
EC3: breadcrumbs.jsonl does not exist — create with the new dispatch entry; no crash on append
EC4: phase=building fires but .evaluator-active already exists (double-fire) — idempotent: phase written again, flag recreated, no error
verification_method: 1) bash -n library/cursor/hooks/chain-evaluator.sh → exit 0. 2) pytest tests/eval/test_chain_evaluator_dispatch.py -v → all AC7 cases pass (runtime stdout JSON + file side effects in chdir fixture). 3) Manual spot-check EC1 (no task_id) and EC4 (double-fire) via pytest parametrization or dedicated test cases in same file.
